name: places.search_places
description: Search for nearby places like restaurants, coffee shops, gas stations, gyms, etc. Can search by type, keyword, or both.

query.description: Search query or keyword (e.g., 'coffee shops', 'italian restaurants', 'gas stations')

location.description: Location to search near. Can be 'current location', city name, or address. If not provided, uses user's default location.

radius.description: Search radius in meters (default: 5000, max: 50000). 1 mile ≈ 1609 meters

open_now.description: If true, only return places that are currently open

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20)
